definitions.recent_peak: g(max complete 7-day mean ending t-28 .. t-1); none -> c(t)
definitions.season_exact: g(max complete 7-day mean inside [t+1-365, t+H-365]); none -> season_wide value
definitions.season_none: 1 if the wide window has no complete block (then season_exact = season_wide = 0)

fit.not_converged: model not used; stop and report

model: logistic regression per (m, H) combination, 21 models, fit on method-period prediction dates, targets per scoring.target_status, labels per candidates.judge (null labels dropped)
revision_rule: during the method period, the only allowed change is adding features (never removing or changing one), as a new sealed version; ridge_lambda, max_iter, tol, the fitting procedure, the training-data selection and the row order stay at the naive-v1 values; added features also go into the stick-chart model; v1 results are published alongside
row_order: rows sorted by (prediction date, tag name) ascending before fitting (fit_rows); tag names are unique within the tag list; duplicate (date, tag) stops the fit
training_data: all prediction dates (prediction weekday) in the method period's prediction range; all tags of the sealed tag list with status target; label = candidates.judge with the sealed V; null labels dropped; nothing else dropped
